summary.text: Janeen Connolly, a Democrat, has represented District 8 in the Arizona House of Representatives since January 13, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Boise, Idaho, and earned an associate degree from Maricopa Community College in 1989, a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 1991, and a graduate degree from Arizona State University in 2011.
Her career experience includes working in government relations and teaching communications at Arizona State University.
